findings.title: Node's kubelet has no plugin for the claim's driver
findings.cause: the pod is on node kd-faults-control-plane and ResourceClaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-lzpcr-gpu-q5zrb is allocated devices from DRA driver fpga.example.com, but the node's kubelet has no plugin for that driver registered, so it cannot prepare them and the containers never start; Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Failed to prepare dynamic resources: prepare dynamic resources: DRA driver fpga.example.com is not registered

evidence.what: ResourceClaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-lzpcr-gpu-q5zrb is allocated device fpga-0 of pool shared from driver fpga.example.com
driver fpga.example.com's slices, which offered the devices

findings.fix: Run driver fpga.example.com's kubelet plugin on node kd-faults-control-plane (it is usually a DaemonSet: check that it has a pod there, and its logs for why it did not register). A ResourceSlice that offers devices on nodes without the plugin (allNodes, or a node selector) lets the scheduler place pods where nothing can prepare them.
